status: Frozen forward protocol prior to study execution; not prospective preregistration
target_policy: Baseline clipped into rules-only reference bounds, identical across paired arms; energy target identical.
objective_policy: Calorie absolute deviation + food-selection cost. Active slack bounds fixed at zero (no slack penalty in accepted solves).

endpoints.primary: Paired difference in independently verified feasibility versus rules-only (reported by model, threshold, mode)
secondary: Changed dish count and total serving change versus rules-only
Plate dish count and food mass (g)
Solver runtime, termination status, and mip_gap

statistical_unit: Participant (N=100); 2,000 paired participant-level bootstrap resamples with seed 20261120
disclosures: Exploratory sensitivity grid, not clinically validated cutoffs
Computational engineering study; no claim of clinical efficacy, causal risk reduction, or external Indian clinical validity
Same-model risk score reduction is descriptive only and not evidence of health benefit
A 3-second timeout does not prove mathematical infeasibility
Rules-only arm is solved once per participant/mode and reused as reference
